evidence.summary: 本地诊断：DGS10 5D -12bp (69%); DGS30 5D -13bp (74%); parallel bull / mixed; real-yield; technical exhaustion absent。

narratives.title: Fed path repricing
narratives.core: The strongest policy-path evidence is the 63-observation bear flattening background, not a fresh 5D shock.
checks: DGS3 5D move is -4bp, while DGS10 5D move is -12bp.
SOFR futures implied cuts are unavailable.
Fed funds futures implied cuts are unavailable.
narratives.interpretation: Policy-path repricing remains a background narrative, but 2026-05-28 does not show a fresh front-end-led shock.

evidence.text: 3Y is up +68bp over 63 valid observations, while the 5D window is -4bp.

narratives.title: Growth scare / recession hedge
narratives.core: The 5D nominal rally and lower breakevens are consistent with a mild hedge bid, but risk proxies do not confirm a recession-style shock.
checks: CNN Fear & Greed is greed as of 2026-05-22; VIX is neutral and junk bond demand / HY OAS is fear.
narratives.interpretation: The growth-scare narrative is weak because the 5D rally is small and the broader risk tape is mixed rather than decisively defensive.

evidence.text: DGS10 fell -12bp over 5D, while CNN risk proxies are mixed.

narratives.title: Risk appetite / liquidity shock
narratives.core: Risk appetite is mixed: headline CNN Fear & Greed is in greed, while junk-bond-demand internals are weaker.
checks: CNN Fear & Greed is greed as of 2026-05-22; VIX is neutral and junk bond demand / HY OAS is fear.
DXY and funding stress data are unavailable.
narratives.interpretation: Risk/liquidity does not dominate the rates signal, but weak credit appetite keeps the duration read conditional.

evidence.text: CNN Fear & Greed is greed as of 2026-05-22; VIX is neutral and junk bond demand / HY OAS is fear.

narratives.title: Inflation compensation shock
narratives.core: Breakevens are positive over 21/63 observations but softer over the 5D window, so inflation compensation is not the main shock on 2026-05-28.
checks: Oil, gasoline, and commodity basket data are unavailable.
narratives.interpretation: Inflation compensation is a weak watch item; there is no broad breakeven-led rates selloff in the local 5D tape.

evidence.text: 5Y breakeven fell -5bp over 5D while T5YIFR moved -5bp.

narratives.title: Long-end term premium / fiscal supply
narratives.core: Local curve proxies do not show independent 30Y stress over the 5D window.
checks: ACM / Kim-Wright term premium is unavailable.
Auction tail and bid-to-cover are unavailable.
narratives.interpretation: The absence of 30Y-led bear steepening argues against upgrading long-end duration, but it also removes the main long-end stress veto for 2026-05-28.

evidence.text: 10s30s flattened -1bp over 5D, so the term-premium proxy is not deteriorating.

narratives.title: Technical positioning / exhaustion
narratives.core: Technical indicators do not show a clear yield-up exhaustion setup on 2026-05-28.
checks: CFTC Treasury futures positioning: Lev net -31.8% OI as of 2026-05-12; 4W +2.9 pts
Timing overlay: No standalone timing signal
narratives.interpretation: Technical signals are not strong enough to create or upgrade a duration action without a fundamental shock.

durationAction.label: No trade / wait
durationAction.explanation: 2026-05-28 does not show an extreme 5D rates shock, 30Y stress is not the binding problem, and technical exhaustion is absent; the duration panel stays at No trade / wait.
reasons: Top narratives: Fed path repricing score 1; Growth scare / recession hedge score 1; Risk appetite / liquidity shock score 1.
supports: 5D curve proxies do not show fresh 30Y-led bear steepening.
The 5D rates move is small enough that there is no need to chase duration.
Local CNN headline risk appetite is not in broad panic.
opposes: 10Y and 30Y shock percentiles are not extreme in the available local-cache window.
Technical exhaustion is not confirmed by RSI, Bollinger z-score, 20D percentile, or nine-turn proxy.
SOFR/Fed funds futures, MOVE, formal term premium, and CFTC positioning are unavailable.
upgradeSignals: Move to index 2 if DGS10 5D or 21D selloff reaches >=85th percentile, real yield leads, and technical exhaustion appears.
Move to index 3 if 10Y shock becomes extreme while 30Y term-premium proxies remain stable.
Move to index 4 only if 30Y shock is extreme and 5s30s/10s30s steepening stops after term-premium pressure stabilizes.
Move to index 5 only after long-end stabilization coincides with bull flattening, growth/disinflation confirmation, and exhaustion.
downgradeSignals: Stay at index 0 if DGS3 or DGS30 accelerates without exhaustion.
Stay at index 0 if 10s30s bear steepening resumes or auction/MOVE data later show stress.
